user.title: Petra trip tracker
user.description: Unofficial integration for school/service transport trips booked through the Petra platform (e.g. Cabonline Serviceresor / Skoltransport). Choose the operator's country and how to log in.

login.title: Log in
login.description: Use the same username (e-mail) and password as in the operator's app or web page. A one-time code is then sent to you by SMS. The password is not stored; Home Assistant asks you to log in again when the login expires (about every 30 days).

code.title: SMS code
code.description: Enter the code from the SMS. If it did not arrive or has expired, tick "Send a new code" and submit.

token.title: Paste a token
token.description: Paste a login token (JWT) copied from the web client: open the browser developer tools, look at a request to the API and copy the value after `Authorization: JWT`. Tokens are valid for about 30 days; you will be asked for a new one when it expires.

reauth.title: Log in again
reauth.description: The login to the Petra service has expired or expires soon.

menu_options.login: Log in with username and password

reconfigure.title: Log in again
reconfigure.description: Log in again to the Petra service, or switch between logging in and a pasted token. The account must stay the same.

menu_options.login: Log in with username and password

error.invalid_token: This does not look like a valid token (JWT).
error.wrong_user: This login belongs to a different account.
error.operator_config: The operator configuration could not be used (API key rejected).
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Petra service.
error.invalid_code: Wrong or expired code. Try again, or ask for a new code.

data.idle_interval_min: Poll interval when no trip is near
data.lead_time_min: Start fast polling this long before a scheduled pickup
data.eta_granularity_min: Fire ETA event when ETA changes by at least
data.heartbeat_min: Heartbeat event interval during a trip (0 = off)
data.late_warning_min: Warn if no car is assigned this long before pickup (0 = at pickup time)
data.failure_alert_min: Fire connection-degraded event after failing for
data.track_onboard: Track the car after pickup (ETA to destination)
data.telemetry: Store redacted API responses locally (for analysis)
data.end_near_destination_m: A trip ended within this distance of the destination counts as arrived

data_description.routing: Straight line needs no external service. OSRM, OpenRouteService and Waze give road-based (Waze: live-traffic) ETAs, but receive the car's position and the trip's pickup and destination locations. If the engine fails, the straight-line estimate is used.
data_description.routing_url: Leave empty for the engine's public server (OSRM: the project-osrm.org demo server; please self-host for regular use). Set it to use your own OSRM or OpenRouteService server.
data_description.routing_api_key: Needed for the public OpenRouteService server (free key at openrouteservice.org).
data_description.end_near_destination_m: Drivers often end the trip shortly before reaching the destination (seen: 300-550 m before the school). A trip ended farther away is reported as ended before the destination, with an estimated arrival.

error.api_key_required: The public OpenRouteService server needs an API key (or set the URL of your own server).

options.token: A token copied from the web page (advanced)
